title: tragia alienata
intro: Tragia alienata, commonly known as Devil's horsewhip, is a plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which can help to alleviate conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Tragia alienata include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
